newsitem.title: GERMANY: Body probably that of businessman-German police.
newsitem.headline: Body probably that of businessman-German police.

text.p: German investigators said on Saturday a body they had found in countryside outside Frankfurt earlier in the day was almost certainly that of kidnapped businessman Jakub Fiszman.
A police spokesman said the body was "with all probability verging on certainty" that of Fiszman, who was abducted on October 1 outside his office.

"According to the information we have so far, we believe that in all probability verging on certainty, the body is that of Jakub Fiszman," Klaus Timm, the head of the regional police force, told a news conference.
Police found the body earlier on Saturday in woodland outside Frankfurt where they had been concentrating their search for the multi-millionaire over the past few days.
Fiszman's brother Georg paid a ransom of four million marks ($2.6 million) on October 10, but his kidnappers reneged on an agreement and failed to free him the following day.
The last sign that Fiszman was alive came the day after his kidnap, when he made a telephone call to a friend.
